findings.text: The 3,693-line aggregate omits the per-package measurements required by the task and described as complete in the status file. Fix: Report the unchanged before-and-after counts separately for SQL text (1,945), conformance (1,042), public documentation tools (134), and other Lean files (572).

The one-time cost credits six lines removed from `SqlRunRules.lean` even though those deletions remove dispatch entries and an import specific to the two pilot kinds. Fix: Charge the deletions to their respective kinds and update the one-time and per-kind subtotals.

The caller totals include whole-file edits to `StepContinuesOk`, `PlainInsertSuccess`, and `SchemaStepRules`, including the deleted laws themselves, despite the stated exclusion. Fix: Count changes to caller declarations separately from changes to the laws they call.

The record counts one changed `sql_run` proof in `S6AutoAddCustomer`, but both `addCustomer_adds_by_sql_run` and `addCustomer_adds_triple` changed their `modeled` and `success` cases. Fix: Report four changed existing proofs across the two fixtures and keep the newly added proof separate.

The baseline counts stop at record-field assignments inside `runScriptStep_createTable` and `Sql.check_send_createTable`, although both statements continue for 12 lines through the `:= by` that starts the proof. Fix: Change the two counts to 12 and the ten-law total to 125.

The replacement count includes only the nine lines of `runScriptStep_createTable_eq` even though the row also names the five-line `step_guards_hold` and other rows count retained theorems. Fix: Report 14 lines for the pair or give separate columns for new and retained statement lines.

The table attributes both INSERT surface witnesses to `Sql.check_send_of_rule`, but `ReplacedSendLaws.lean` uses `Sql.check_send_of_step` for `check_send_plainInsert` and `check_send_single_of_step` for `ifOk_send_plainInsert`. Fix: List the actual derivation for each witness, including the shared `plainInsert_database` fact, and update the replacement counts.

The 60-line subtotal labels `Database.tableNamed_createTable` as new even though it existed at `b7854558`, and the retention fixture uses `Database.table_createTable_end` only for the empty-table law. Fix: Describe the subtotal as covering new and revised statements and remove the claim that every theorem serves several replaced laws.
The timing table omits `StepRuleAttr`, which provides the new rule set and has a measured minimum of 0.45 seconds in `after-timing-modules.tsv`. Fix: Add its after-only timing row.

The claim that `sql_run [rfl]` cannot close concrete CREATE TABLE resolution contradicts `closeSide`, which retries each hint with `with_unfolding_all`, and `SchemaRuleExamples.allKinds_closes_the_transaction`, which uses that hint on a script containing CREATE TABLE. Fix: Distinguish the direct `rfl` failure from the successful `sql_run [rfl]` call.

The two cited data-fixture modules account for 111 of the 243 client-test code lines, which does not support the claim that they contain most of the lines. Fix: Report the measured split of 111 lines in those modules and 132 in `ItemInsertClaims`.
The record says CREATE TABLE had at most two review rounds, while the status log lists reviews of `c86380e4`, `657e7308`, and `dc483d3a`. Fix: Report three CREATE TABLE review rounds.
